answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake subject to cryptographic stake burning under quadratic penalty slashing. If nodes harbor duplicate identities, their marginal collateral cost scales superlinearly as O(N^2), imposing devastating economic friction. Attackers cannot camouflage identities like pigment or bend under slashing like a willow, as exponential stake forfeiture renders massive identity proliferation mathematically unviable.
